mapper.select:
SELECT , e.employee_name FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN hrm_employee e ON u.employee_id = e.id WHERE u.is_deleted = 0
AND (u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND u.status = #{status}
ORDER BY u.create_time DESC

SELECT , e.employee_name FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_user_dept ud ON u.id = ud.user_id AND ud.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN hrm_employee e ON u.employee_id = e.id WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 AND ud.dept_id = #{deptId} ORDER BY u.create_time DESC

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE is_deleted = 0) AS total_users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auth_online_device WHERE status = 'online') AS online_users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND create_time >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) AS new_users_this_month

SELECT r.role_name, COUNT(ur.user_id) AS user_count FROM sys_role r LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON r.id = ur.role_id AND ur.is_deleted = 0 WHERE r.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY r.id, r.role_name ORDER BY user_count DESC

SELECT d.dept_name, COUNT(ud.user_id) AS user_count FROM sys_dept d LEFT JOIN sys_user_dept ud ON d.id = ud.dept_id AND ud.is_deleted = 0 WHERE d.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY d.id, d.dept_name ORDER BY user_count DESC
